name: Patty Judge
desc: 46th Lieutenant Governor and former Secretary of Agriculture for the U.S. State of Iowa.
summary: Patty Jean Judge (née Poole; born November 2, 1943) is an American politician who served as the 45th lieutenant governor of Iowa from 2007 to 2011 and the 13th secretary of agriculture of Iowa from 1999 to 2007. She unsuccessfully ran for re-election as lieutenant governor in 2010 after being elected to the office in 2006 with Chet Culver as governor.
